title.en: Ginger hair portraits show unexpected 'golden thread' connecting Americans
title.zh: 红发肖像展现连接美国人的意想不到的“金色纽带”

summary.en: Photographer Kieran Dodds has spent over a decade capturing portraits of people with red hair, discovering an unexpected commonality that connects Americans.
summary.zh: 摄影师基兰·多兹在过去十多年里一直致力于拍摄红发人士的肖像，他发现红发是连接美国人的一条意想不到的“金色纽带”。

body.en:
For Kieran Dodds, photographing people with red hair has become something of an obsession over the past decade.

The 45-year-old, from Edinburgh, who is himself a "proud ginger", began taking pictures in his homeland in 2013 as part of a series examining Scottish identity.

His interest in the subject soon took him to other ginger hotspots such the Russian city of Perm and Jamaica's Treasure Beach.

His 2020 book Gingers spanned the world but after its release he notice there was a "huge gap".

"I was like 'oh wow, of course, the whole world is in the States'," Kieran says. "It's a microcosm."

He says a message from a Native American man who had red hair instantly aroused his curiosity.

"I found it very interesting and it made me think, 'where on earth did it come from?'"

The cover of his latest book - Gingers of America , external - features Joshua Elliot from the Muscogee (Creek) Nation in Oklahoma.

He told Kieran that some of his mother's relatives were German and on his dad's side there were people from England and Sweden, so that could explain where his ginger hair comes from.

"My mom's side has always been involved with the Muscogee tribe and traditions and I've grown up around it," he said.

Joshua knows he does not fit people's expectations of what a Native American should look like, but he said: "Our chief's wife told me it's about your involvement in your community and your tribe, the people around you and what you put back into it.

Kieran spoke to a lot of Native Americans on his visits and most knew of a European ancestry which could explain their red hair.

"The thing that surprised me was how early on there were these Scots and Irish marrying Native Americans," he said.

Lottie Wahkinney, a Comanche girl from Oklahoma, has Scottish grandparents, from Galashiels.

Her father Jared told Kieran his dad was Comanche but his mum was born and raised in Scotland.

"On my first visit to Scotland when I was 22, folks were like, 'Where are your moccasins? Where's your headdress?'.

While most Native Americans could explain where the ginger gene might have come from, there was one exception - a Cherokee girl called Lakia - whose family knew of no European ancestry.

In the book, Lakia says that all her family, on both sides, have jet-black straight hair but hers turned red during her childhood.

After meeting Native Americans, Kieran knew there was something in the US he could explore.

Over the next few years, he made seven lengthy trips, often linked to his full-time profession as an environmental photographer.

One state he found surprising was Alabama, a place many in the UK associate with racial segregation and the struggle for civil rights as well as its pioneering space exploration programmes.

body.zh: 对于基兰·多兹 (Kieran Dodds) 来说，在过去的十年里，拍摄红头发的人已经成为一种痴迷。 这位来自爱丁堡的 45 岁男子本身就是一个“骄傲的姜黄色人”，他于 2013 年开始在自己的祖国拍摄照片，作为审视苏格兰身份的系列照片的一部分。 由于对这一主题的兴趣，他很快就去了其他生姜热点地区，例如俄罗斯城市彼尔姆和牙买加的宝藏海滩。 他 2020 年出版的新书《Gingers》遍布世界各地，但在出版后他注意到存在“巨大差距”。 “我当时想，‘哦，哇，当然，整个世界都在美国’，”基兰说。 “这是一个缩影。” 他说，一位红头发的美洲原住民发来的信息立即引起了他的好奇心。 “我发现这非常有趣，这让我思考，‘它到底来自哪里？’” 他的新书《美国红人》（Gingers of America）的封面由来自俄克拉荷马州马斯科吉（克里克）民族的约书亚·埃利奥特（Joshua Elliot）担任主角。 他告诉基兰，他母亲的一些亲戚是德国人，而他父亲这边有来自英国和瑞典的人，所以这可以解释他姜黄色头发的来源。 “我妈妈那边一直参与马斯科吉部落和传统，我就是在它周围长大的，”他说。 约书亚知道他不符合人们对美洲原住民的期望，但他说：“我们酋长的妻子告诉我，这关系到你对你的社区和部落、你周围的人的参与以及你对其中的投入。 基兰在访问期间与许多美洲原住民进行了交谈，大多数人都知道欧洲血统可以解释他们的红头发。 “令我惊讶的是，这些苏格兰人和爱尔兰人很早就与美洲原住民结婚了，”他说。 洛蒂·沃金尼 (Lottie Wahkinney) 是一位来自俄克拉荷马州的科曼奇女孩，她的祖父母来自加拉希尔斯 (Galashiels) 苏格兰人。 她的父亲贾里德告诉基兰，他的父亲是科曼奇人，但他的母亲在苏格兰出生和长大。 “当我 22 岁时第一次访问苏格兰时，人们会问，‘你的鹿皮鞋在哪里？你的头饰在哪里？ 虽然大多数美洲原住民都能解释生姜基因可能来自何处，但有一个例外 - 一位名叫拉基亚 (Lakia) 的切罗基女孩 - 她的家人不知道欧洲血统。 拉基亚在书中说，她的双方家人都有乌黑的直发，但她的头发在童年时期变成了红色。 在见到美洲原住民后，基兰知道美国有一些他可以探索的地方。 在接下来的几年里，他进行了七次长途旅行，这些旅行通常与他作为环境摄影师的全职职业有关。 他感到惊讶的一个州是阿拉巴马州，许多英国人都将这个地方与种族隔离、民权斗争及其开创性的太空探索计划联系在一起。 “在我的脑海里，它停留在 60 年代，但是......

reflection.en: This story reminds us that beneath our visible differences, Yahweh often weaves unexpected threads of connection among us. It highlights how shared traits, even seemingly minor ones like hair color, can reveal a deeper unity that transcends superficial distinctions.
reflection.zh: 这个故事提醒我们，在我们可见的差异之下，雅伟常常在我们中间编织出意想不到的连接纽带。它强调了即使是像发色这样看似微小的共同特征，也能揭示超越表面区别的更深层统一。

title.en: On the front line of Europe's battle against wildfires
title.zh: 欧洲抗击野火前线

summary.en: French firefighters successfully contained a massive blaze, allowing nearly 200,000 evacuated residents to return home. However, experts warn that Europe's wildfire season, intensified by climate change, is expected to continue.
summary.zh: 法国消防员成功扑灭了一场大火，近20万撤离居民得以返回家园。然而，专家警告称，受气候影响，欧洲的野火季节远未结束。

body.en:
French firefighters have won out over a massive blaze, with almost 200,000 evacuees returning home. But Europe's climate-fueled wildfire season is far from over.

The signal to move comes suddenly — and within a minute or so the fire truck is full and speeding off into the distance, a cloud of orange dust swirling in its wake. "There's always a bit of adrenaline when you get the call," marine firefighter Julien says. "But we're trained; we're prepared."

Maitre Julien — whom DW can only identity by rank and first name — is part of Marseille-based battalion deployed to France's Gironde region to tackle a wildfire which prompted the largest evacuations in the country since World War II.

Some 264 firefighters were injured in the fight against the Gironde fire, four of whom lost their lives. In nearby towns, French flags still fly at half mast to mark the loss. "It's always on our mind," Lieutenant Damien, another marine firefighter, explains as his team members haul the firehose out behind him.

Letitia, a firefighter and medic, said she tries to ask how colleagues are feeling "without being too intrusive."

"It's the fatigue above all," she says when asked about the most common problem affecting her colleagues. "They're sleeping very little."

"Do you see all all of that?" Maitre Julien asks, gesturing out the car window as he drives past rows of blackened trees and swathes of scorched earth at the roadside. "All of that's already burned. But you can see small peels of smoke here and there. We absolutely have to extinguish those so fires don't restart."

When Julien pulls up at another hotspot, the risk of flare-ups comes sharply into focus: The air smells burned and a cloud of white smoke fills the sky. Within about 20 minutes, the smoke turns thick and black, and the fire — previously under control — was visible burning bright again through the trees.

Here by the firefighters' side are improvised teams of local volunteers — farmers and tradesmen and women who took it upon themselves to use their tractors or vans or four-by-fours to transport water to firefighters on the front line, and often head into the blazes themselves without proper protective gear or training.

"We're here because we're needed. And because we want to help," Steven Page, one volunteer, told DW. Maitre Julien said they played a "primordial" role, saving firefighters "precious time" in the fight.

At times, firefighters said, this felt like a "David and Goliath" battle. But they came out on top. By Saturday, France's Interior Ministry declared the fire was no longer progressing. Most of the 220,000 evacuees were allowed to return home.

body.zh: 法国消防队员战胜了大火，近 20 万名疏散人员已返回家园。但欧洲气候引发的野火季节还远未结束。 移动的信号突然来了——大约一分钟左右，消防车就装满了水，飞速驶向远方，尾随一团橙色的尘埃在旋转。 “接到电话时，你总是会感到肾上腺素飙升，”海军陆战队消防员朱利安说。 “但我们受过训练；我们已经做好准备。” 德国之声只能通过军衔和名字确认朱利安大师的身份，他是部署在法国吉伦特省地区的马赛营的一员，该营的任务是扑灭野火，这场野火引发了该国自二战以来最大规模的疏散行动。 大约 264 名消防员在扑灭吉伦特省大火的过程中受伤，其中 4 人丧生。在附近的城镇，法国国旗仍然下半旗以纪念这一损失。 “这一直在我们的脑海中，”另一名海军陆战队消防员达米安中尉解释说，他的团队成员在他身后拖出消防水龙带。 消防员兼医务人员利蒂西亚表示，她试图“不过度打扰”地询问同事的感受。 当被问及影响同事的最常见问题时，她说：“首先是疲劳。” “他们睡得很少。” “你看到这一切了吗？”朱利安师傅一边开车经过路边一排排焦黑的树木和大片焦土，一边指着车窗外问道。 “所有这些都已经被烧毁了。但是你可以看到到处都有小片烟雾。我们绝对必须扑灭这些烟雾，这样火灾就不会重新发生。” 当朱利安在另一个热点地区停下来时，爆发的风险突然成为人们关注的焦点：空气中弥漫着烧焦的味道，天空中弥漫着一团白烟。大约 20 分钟内，浓烟变得又浓又黑，之前已经得到控制的火势在树林中再次熊熊燃烧。 在消防队员身边，有由当地志愿者组成的临时队伍——农民、商人和妇女，他们自己使用拖拉机、货车或四轮四轮车为前线的消防队员运送水，并且经常在没有适当防护装备或训练的情况下亲自冲入大火。 “我们来这里是因为我们需要帮助。”志愿者史蒂文·佩奇（Steven Page）告诉德国之声。朱利安师傅表示，他们发挥了“原始”作用，为消防员节省了“宝贵的时间”。 消防队员说，有时这感觉就像一场“大卫与歌利亚”的战斗。但他们最终脱颖而出。到周六，法国内政部宣布火势不再蔓延。 22万名撤离者中的大多数被允许返回家园。 在欧洲其他地方，战斗的激烈程度还远未结束：希腊和西班牙的野火也在肆虐——其他国家正在……

reflection.en: While we celebrate the heroic efforts of firefighters and the safe return of evacuees, this news reminds us that creation itself groans under the weight of environmental challenges. Yahweh's word acknowledges the deep impact of such struggles, even as we find strength to face ongoing seasons of difficulty.
reflection.zh: 尽管我们为消防员的英勇努力和撤离居民的平安归家而欢欣，但这则新闻提醒我们，受环境挑战的影响，受造界本身仍在叹息。雅伟的话语承认这些挣扎的深远影响，即便我们要在持续的困难季节中寻找力量。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Queensland reveals concept plans for Brisbane Olympic stadium precinct – but critics say they are ‘fantasy vision’
title.zh: 昆士兰公布布里斯班奥运场馆区概念规划——但批评者称其为“幻想愿景”

summary.en: The Queensland government has unveiled concept plans for the Brisbane Olympic stadium precinct, intended to surround the 2032 Olympic Games. While officials expressed confidence that the project would be enjoyed for generations, critics have dismissed the plans as a "fantasy vision" due to a perceived lack of detail.

reflection.zh: 布里斯班奥运场馆区的宏伟愿景，虽然承诺能让后代享受，但也因其长期可行性而受到审视。这提醒我们，即使是最雄心勃勃的人类努力，例如争取奥运桂冠，最终也只是为了一个会朽坏的奖赏。雅伟邀请我们思考，除了暂时的胜利和宏伟的设计之外，真正持久的是什么。

verse.textEn: Everyone who competes in the games goes into strict training. They do it to get a crown that will not last, but we do it to get a crown that will last forever.

title.en: Trump says he is cancelling strikes on Iran subject to deal being made 'rapidly'
title.zh: 特朗普称他将取消对伊朗的袭击，前提是协议能“迅速”达成

summary.en: The US president announced the cancellation of planned military strikes on Iran, stating that the decision was made after Iran and other Middle Eastern nations requested a halt to allow for a rapid agreement on a deal. He claimed the "perimeters" of a deal had already been agreed upon.
summary.zh: 美国总统宣布取消对伊朗的军事打击计划，称此决定是在伊朗及其他中东国家要求暂停袭击，以便迅速达成协议后作出的。他声称协议的“范围”已经达成一致。

body.en:
Donald Trump says he has cancelled strikes against Iran provided a deal was struck "rapidly" with the country.

In a post on Truth Social, the US president claimed he was asked by Iran and other countries in the Middle East to "hold off" on any attack as the "perimeters" of a deal had been agreed, which he said would include reopening the Strait of Hormuz and ending Iran's nuclear threat.

His comments came after US media reported that Washington may have been planning new, intense strikes on Iran over the weekend.

Earlier on Saturday, Tehran had accused the US of escalating tensions, saying any regional state co-operating with Washington would be "engulfed by the flames of war".

Meanwhile the US government urged Americans across the Middle East to be alert and ready to leave "should there be escalation" in the region.

"Americans currently in the Middle East should exercise caution and heightened vigilance and should be prepared for flight cancellations, periodic airspace closures, and potential travel disruptions," the security alert said on Saturday.

Multiple sources had earlier told CBS News, the BBC's American media partner, that the US and Israel were planning what would be one of the harshest bombing campaigns to date against energy infrastructure targets in Iran.

The plan came up during Trump's cabinet meeting on Friday, sources told CBS News.

Trump further said in his post the US was "locked and loaded and ready to go against the Islamic Republic of Iran, at levels of Military Terror, Strength, and Power not seen since World War II".

He said cancelling the attack would be "for the future benefit of the world and, likewise, the survival of a successful and prosperous Iran".

During the Friday meeting, CBS News reported Trump was heard saying while reporters were still in the room: "We'll be hitting them [Iranians] very hard. At some point, they're going to say, 'We just can't take it anymore.'"

Axios reported that Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman spoke to Trump on Saturday and "expressed concern" about the potential strikes. Reuters also reported the phone call.

Washington and Tehran have engaged in escalating strikes and counter-strikes since a ceasefire in April aimed at pausing the war fell apart in June.

Earlier this week, the US said it completed a "heavy wave" of strikes against Iran in retaliation for an attempted ballistic missile attack on American forces in the region.

The US has blockaded Iranian ports and bombed Iranian sites, while Iran has fired missiles and drones at US assets in countries across the Middle East and targeted shipping in the Strait of Hormuz, a vital waterway for global oil shipping.

body.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普表示，只要与伊朗“迅速”达成协议，他就取消了对伊朗的打击。 美国总统在《Truth Social》上发表的一篇文章中声称，伊朗和中东其他国家要求他“暂缓”任何袭击，因为协议的“边界”已经达成，他表示，协议将包括重新开放霍尔木兹海峡和结束伊朗的核威胁。 他发表此番言论之前，美国媒体报道称，华盛顿可能正计划在周末对伊朗进行新的、猛烈的打击。 周六早些时候，德黑兰指责美国加剧紧张局势，称任何与华盛顿合作的地区国家都将“被战火吞没”。 与此同时，美国政府敦促中东各地的美国人保持警惕，并准备好离开“如果该地区局势升级”。 安全警报周六表示：“目前在中东的美国人应谨慎行事，提高警惕，并应对航班取消、空域定期关闭和潜在的旅行中断做好准备。” 多个消息来源早些时候告诉英国广播公司的美国媒体合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司新闻，美国和以色列正在计划对伊朗能源基础设施目标进行迄今为止最严厉的轰炸行动之一。 消息人士告诉哥伦比亚广播公司新闻，该计划是在特朗普周五的内阁会议上提出的。 特朗普在帖子中进一步表示，美国“已经上膛，准备好以二战以来从未见过的军事恐怖、实力和实力对抗伊朗伊斯兰共和国”。 他表示，取消袭击将“为了世界未来的利益，同样也为了一个成功和繁荣的伊朗的生存”。 据哥伦比亚广播公司新闻报道，在周五的会议上，当记者们还在房间里时，有人听到特朗普说：“我们将非常严厉地打击他们（伊朗人）。到了某个时候，他们会说，‘我们再也受不了了。’” Axios 报道称，沙特王储穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼周六与特朗普通话，并对潜在的袭击“表达了担忧”。路透社也报道了这通电话。 自四月份旨在暂停战争的停火协议于六月份破裂以来，华盛顿和德黑兰一直在不断升级打击和反击。 本周早些时候，美国表示，它完成了对伊朗的“猛烈”打击，以报复对该地区美军的弹道导弹袭击。 美国封锁了伊朗港口并轰炸了伊朗地点，而伊朗则向美国在中东各国的资产发射了导弹和无人机，并瞄准了霍尔木兹海峡的航运，霍尔木兹海峡是全球石油运输的重要水道。 2月28日，美国和以色列开始对伊朗发动打击，战争爆发导致……

reflection.en: At moments of heightened tension, the decision to step back from conflict and pursue dialogue is a profound act. Yahweh blesses those who actively work to bridge divides and prevent violence, for they reflect His own desire for reconciliation. May leaders everywhere be guided towards paths of peace, seeking understanding over confrontation.
reflection.zh: 在局势高度紧张之际，决定从冲突中退后并寻求对话，是一种意义深远的行动。雅伟赐福那些积极弥合分歧、防止暴力的人，因为他们反映了祂对和解的渴望。愿各地的领袖都能被引导走向和平之路，寻求理解而非对抗。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: Trump to hold off on new Iran attack, in hope of a swift deal
title.zh: 特朗普将暂缓对伊朗发动新袭击，寄望迅速达成协议

summary.en: US President Donald Trump announced he would delay a new attack on Iran, expressing hope that negotiators could quickly reach an agreement to fully reopen the Strait of Hormuz.
summary.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，他将推迟对伊朗的新一轮袭击，并希望谈判人员能迅速达成协议，以“立即、全面、彻底”地重新开放霍尔木兹海峡。

body.en:
United States President Donald Trump will hold off a fresh attack on Iran as long as a deal can be reached quickly to halt Iran's nuclear ambitions and re-open the Strait of Hormuz.

According to a post by Trump on his Truth Social platform, Iran and "other Middle Eastern countries" have asked for a time to complete a deal that would lead to "the Immediate, Complete and Total" reopening of the Strait and "an end to Iran's nuclear threa t.

"Based on this request, I have agreed, for the future benefit of the WORLD and, likewise, the survival of a successful and prosperous Iran, to cancel the attack, subject to being able to rapidly make a DEAL," he said on the post.

Trump also said "Israel joins me in this commitment" although Israel has not made a public statement about the comment.

Iran has warned the US this weekend against any "adventurous action" and said it would retaliate decisively if US forces followed through on Trump's threats of fresh attacks on Iranian targets.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Iranian foreign minister Abbas Araghchi's made these comments in separate phone calls with senior Turkish, Pakistani and Saudi officials hours after Kuwait's army said it destroyed hostile drones launched by Iran against several vital facilities.

In his discussion with Pakistan's Army Chief Field Marshal Asim Munir and Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan, Araghchi said Iran would respond decisively to any "aggression" and discussed the consequences of “destabilising actions" by the US, as well as prospects for heightened regional insecurity. This was published on Araghchi's Telegram account.

Araghchi later told Saudi Foreign Minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan that any attacks by the US and Israel or participation by regional countries in such actions would be met with a “proportionate response.” Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman spoke to Trump on Saturday and "expressed concern and asked for clarity" about US plans for Iran, a US official had told Axios.

Nournews, a media outlet affiliated with Iran's top security body, said US attacks on Iranian energy infrastructure would prompt Iranian strikes on oil fields in Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates, as well as the gas fields of Qatar and Israel, saying, "all will be burned to ashes."

At a cabinet meeting on Friday at the Camp David retreat, Trump said he believed US negotiators, including his son-in-law Jared Kushner, special envoy Steve Witkoff and Secretary of State Marco Rubio, could still reach a deal with Iran.

But Trump also said he was losing faith in the Iranians, saying, "They break their word so often" — a claim Tehran has frequently...
body.zh: 只要能够迅速达成协议以制止伊朗的核野心并重新开放霍尔木兹海峡，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普就将推迟对伊朗发动新的攻击。 根据特朗普在其真相社交平台上发布的帖子，伊朗和“其他中东国家”已要求一段时间来完成一项协议，以“立即、全面和彻底”重新开放海峡并“结束伊朗的核威胁”。 他在帖子中表示：“基于这一请求，我同意，为了世界未来的利益，也为了一个成功和繁荣的伊朗的生存，取消这次袭击，但前提是能够迅速达成协议。” 特朗普还表示“以色列与我一起做出这一承诺”，尽管以色列尚未就这一评论发表公开声明。 伊朗本周末警告美国不要采取任何“冒险行动”，并表示，如果美军兑现特朗普的威胁，对伊朗目标发动新的袭击，伊朗将采取果断报复。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 在科威特军队表示摧毁了伊朗针对多个重要设施发射的敌对无人机几小时后，伊朗外交部长阿巴斯·阿拉格奇在分别与土耳其、巴基斯坦和沙特高级官员的电话中发表了上述言论。 阿拉格奇在与巴基斯坦陆军参谋长阿西姆·穆尼尔元帅和土耳其外交部长哈坎·菲丹的讨论中表示，伊朗将对任何“侵略”做出果断反应，并讨论了美国“破坏稳定行动”的后果，以及地区不安全加剧的前景。这是在 Araghchi 的 Telegram 帐户上发布的。 阿拉格奇后来告诉沙特外交大臣费萨尔·本·法尔汉亲王，美国和以色列的任何袭击或地区国家参与此类行动都将得到“适当的回应”。一名美国官员告诉 Axios，沙特王储穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼周六与特朗普通话，“表达了担忧并要求澄清”美国对伊朗的计划。 隶属于伊朗最高安全机构的媒体《Nournews》表示，美国对伊朗能源基础设施的袭击将促使伊朗对沙特阿拉伯和阿联酋的油田以及卡塔尔和以色列的天然气田发动袭击，并称“所有这些都将被烧成灰烬”。 周五在戴维营休养所举行的内阁会议上，特朗普表示，他相信美国谈判代表，包括他的女婿贾里德·库什纳、特使史蒂夫·威特科夫和国务卿马可·卢比奥，仍然可以与伊朗达成协议。 但特朗普也表示，他对伊朗人失去了信心，他说，“他们经常食言”——德黑兰经常这样说……

reflection.en: In moments of international tension, the decision to pursue diplomatic solutions over immediate conflict reflects a commitment to peace. Yahweh's word encourages us to live at peace with everyone, as far as it depends on us, seeking pathways for resolution. This pursuit of peace, even amidst complex challenges, is a testament to the hope for a better way...
reflection.zh: 在国际局势紧张之时，选择通过外交途径而非立即冲突来解决问题，体现了对和平的承诺。雅伟的话语鼓励我们，只要力所能及，就与众人和睦相处，寻求解决之道。这种对和平的追求，即使在复杂的挑战中，也证明了对更好未来的盼望。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Callas, Beethoven, bee-eaters or storks: competition seeks to redesign euro notes
title.zh: 卡拉斯、贝多芬、蜂虎或鹳：欧元纸币重新设计竞赛

summary.en: The European Union is undertaking a competition to redesign its euro notes, aiming to move beyond neutral designs and build a finely balanced identity. Debates include whether to feature figures like Marie Curie, Miguel de Cervantes, Ludwig van Beethoven, or natural elements like bee-eaters or storks.
summary.zh: 欧盟正在举办一场竞赛，重新设计欧元纸币，旨在超越中立设计，构建一个精心平衡的身份。讨论包括是否选用居里夫人、米格尔·德·塞万提斯、路德维希·范·贝多芬等人物，或是蜂虎或鹳等自然元素。

body.en: The EU is using a currency redesign as an opportunity to be less neutral and try some finely balanced identity-building Is Europe best represented by the bold intellect of Marie Curie, the sprawling imagination of Miguel de Cervantes and the intense musical genius of Ludwig van Beethoven? Or by a migrating stork and a bee-eater, swooping across borderless plains and enjoying freedom of movement across European countries? The quest to settle this issue has engaged a surprising number of people across the continent, after more than 6 million people voted in a survey within just a week of its launch to determine whether the newly redesigned euro bank notes should depict either cultural figures or birds and waterways. Continue reading...
body.zh: 欧盟正在利用货币重新设计作为机会，减少中立性，并尝试一些微妙平衡的身份建设。欧洲最好的代表是玛丽·居里的大胆智慧、米格尔·德·塞万提斯的丰富想象力和路德维希·范·贝多芬的强烈音乐天才吗？或者是一只迁徙的鹳鸟和食蜂鸟，飞过无国界的平原，在欧洲各国之间自由行动？解决这一问题的努力吸引了整个欧洲大陆数量惊人的人们的参与，一项调查启动后短短一周内就有超过 600 万人参与投票，以确定新设计的欧元纸币是否应该描绘文化人物或鸟类和水道。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As the European Union considers new designs for its currency, debating whether to feature historical figures, cultural icons, or natural elements, it seeks to define its shared identity. Proverbs 14:34 reminds us that true national exaltation comes from righteousness, prompting reflection on the deeper moral and spiritual foundations that truly elevate a...
reflection.zh: 当欧盟考虑重新设计其货币，讨论是选择历史人物、文化偶像还是自然元素来代表其共同身份时，箴言14:34提醒我们，真正的国家荣耀源于公义。这促使我们思考真正提升一个社会的更深层道德和属灵基础。这种对身份的追求，无论是通过艺术还是人物，最终都指向在雅伟面前真正荣耀一个民族的品格。

verse.textEn: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin condemns any people.
verse.textZh: 公义使邦国高举；罪恶是人民的羞辱。

title.en: ‘We cannot magic up more water’: the supply problems putting housing targets in England at risk
title.zh: “我们无法凭空变出更多水”：供水问题使英格兰的住房目标面临风险

summary.en: Council leaders in England are warning that a lack of water and deteriorating infrastructure are threatening the government's goals for new home construction, particularly in the east and south-east regions. They state that half of the planned housing developments are at risk due to these critical supply problems.
summary.zh: 英格兰地方议会领导人警告称，缺水和基础设施老化正在威胁政府新建住房的目标，尤其是在英格兰东部和东南部地区。他们指出，由于这些关键的供应问题，一半的规划住房开发项目面临风险。

body.en: Council leaders say crumbling infrastructure and lack of water are jeopardising government’s plans for new homes The government’s housebuilding agenda is hitting the stark reality of a lack of water and crumbling infrastructure across the east and south-east of England. Half the country was declared to be in serious drought this week, for the second consecutive year, with the Environment Agency warning of dire consequences for the economy, environment and wildlife. Continue reading...
body.zh: 议会领导人表示，摇摇欲坠的基础设施和缺水正在危及政府的新住房计划政府的住房建设议程正面临英格兰东部和东南部缺水和摇摇欲坠的基础设施的严峻现实。本周，一半的国家被宣布连续第二年陷入严重干旱，环境署警告称，这将对经济、环境和野生动物造成严重后果。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This news highlights the critical importance of responsible resource management, reminding us that the earth and its fullness belong to Yahweh. Our ambitious plans for growth must always be tempered by the reality of finite resources and the need for careful stewardship of creation. We are called to manage what has been entrusted to us with wisdom and...
reflection.zh: 这则新闻凸显了负责任地管理资源的重要性，提醒我们大地和其中所充满的都属于雅伟。我们雄心勃勃的增长计划必须始终以有限资源的现实为前提，并需要谨慎地管理受托的受造物。我们蒙召要以智慧和远见管理所托付的一切，确保子孙后代的永续发展。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: UK’s state investments agency hit by data breach
title.zh: 英国国家投资机构遭遇数据泄露

summary.en: The UK's state investments agency experienced a data breach, exposing sensitive information and contact details of 51 government officials for 40 hours. The incident has led to calls for the public body to enhance its internal security measures.
summary.zh: 英国国家投资机构遭遇数据泄露，导致51名政府官员的敏感信息和联系方式暴露长达40小时。此次事件促使该公共机构加强其内部安全措施。

body.en: Security lapse leaves sensitive information and contact details of 51 government officials exposed for 40 hours The public body in charge of the UK’s state investments has been pushed to improve its internal security after a data breach left “high-level management information” publicly accessible for nearly two days. UK Government Investments (UKGI), the agency that manages the taxpayers’ interest in a swathe of companies including Channel 4 and the Post Office, said the security failure also left more than 50 government officials’ personal details exposed for nearly 40 hours. Continue reading...
body.zh: 安全漏洞导致 51 名政府官员的敏感信息和联系方式暴露 40 小时 在数据泄露导致“高级管理信息”公开近两天后，负责英国国家投资的公共机构被迫改善其内部安全。英国政府投资局（UKGI）负责管理纳税人在第四频道和邮局等一系列公司的利益，该机构表示，安全故障还导致 50 多名政府官员的个人信息在近 40 小时内暴露。继续阅读...

reflection.en: A data breach, even if temporary, highlights the critical importance of faithfulness in managing entrusted information. Yahweh's word reminds us that integrity in seemingly small responsibilities reflects our character and has broader implications for trust and security. This incident underscores the need for diligence in safeguarding what is committed to...
reflection.zh: 即使是暂时的，数据泄露也凸显了忠实管理所托付信息的重要性。雅伟的话语提醒我们，在看似微小的责任上保持正直，反映了我们的品格，并对信任和安全产生更广泛的影响。此次事件强调了在保管我们所受托之物时需要保持勤勉。

verse.textEn: Whoever can be trusted with very little can also be trusted with much, and whoever is dishonest with very little will also be dishonest with much.
verse.textZh: 人在最小的事上忠心，在大事上也忠心；在最小的事上不义，在大事上也不义。

title.en: Three killed after bomb detonated at Moscow restaurant, state media say
title.zh: 国家媒体称，莫斯科餐厅发生炸弹爆炸，三人死亡

summary.en: Security officials reported that three people were killed after a bomb was detonated at a Moscow restaurant. State media indicated that a woman attempted to enter the establishment with explosives but was intercepted by a security guard.
summary.zh: 据国家媒体报道，一枚炸弹在莫斯科一家餐厅引爆，造成三人死亡。安全官员称，一名女子试图携带爆炸物进入餐厅，但被一名保安拦下。

body.en:
At least three people have been killed and 21 injured after a homemade explosive device was detonated at an Italian restaurant in Moscow, Russian state media reports, quoting security officials.

The blast happened at about 20:00 local time (17:00 GMT) on Kudrinskaya square near the city centre.

The National Anti-Terrorist Committee said a woman carrying the explosives tried to enter the restaurant but was stopped by a security guard.

The device detonated, killing the woman, the guard and a visitor to the Balzi Rossi restaurant, which had been holding a private function.

Authorities have not said who they believe was the target, but many Muscovites will suspect a link to the war in Ukraine.

In recent years, several senior Russian military figures have been assassinated in and around the Russian capital. Moscow has blamed Kyiv for those attacks.

Initial reports said the blast happened in the establishment's kitchen but the restaurant later issued a statement saying "there was a problem outside".

The restaurant is located in one of Moscow's famous Stalin-era skyscrapers, with roads around the square briefly closed.

Dozens of cyclists had been gathering nearby for an evening ride through the city but the event was cancelled.

Video released by Russia's RIA news agency showed heavily armed law enforcement officers at the scene, which had been closed off to members of the public.
body.zh: 俄罗斯官方媒体援引安全官员的话报道称，莫斯科一家意大利餐厅发生自制爆炸装置引爆事件，造成至少 3 人死亡、21 人受伤。 爆炸发生在当地时间 20:00 左右（格林威治标准时间 17:00），地点位于市中心附近的库德林斯卡亚广场。 国家反恐委员会表示，一名携带爆炸物的妇女试图进入餐厅，但被保安拦住。 该装置爆炸，导致该名女子、警卫和一名前往 Balzi Rossi 餐厅的客人死亡，该餐厅当时正在举办私人活动。 当局尚未透露他们认为目标是谁，但许多莫斯科人怀疑这与乌克兰战争有关。 近年来，多位俄罗斯高级军事人物在俄罗斯首都及周边地区遭到暗杀。莫斯科将这些袭击归咎于基辅。 最初的报道称爆炸发生在餐厅的厨房，但餐厅后来发表声明称“外面出现了问题”。 该餐厅位于莫斯科著名的斯大林时代摩天大楼之一，广场周围的道路曾短暂封闭。 数十名骑自行车的人聚集在附近，打算晚上骑车穿过城市，但活动被取消了。 俄罗斯通讯社发布的视频显示，现场有全副武装的执法人员，现场已禁止公众进入。

reflection.en: Acts of violence like this remind us of the destructive power of evil in the world. In the face of such darkness, Yahweh calls us not to be overcome by evil, but to actively seek ways to overcome evil with good. This path requires courage and a steadfast commitment to peace, even amidst tragedy.
reflection.zh: 这样的暴力行为提醒我们世间邪恶的破坏力。面对这样的黑暗，雅伟呼召我们不要被邪恶所胜，而是要积极寻求以善胜恶的方法。这条道路需要勇气，以及即使在悲剧中也要坚定不移地致力于和平。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Mountaineer Nirmal Purja killed in Pakistan avalanche, his company says
title.zh: 其公司称，登山家尼尔马尔·普尔贾在巴基斯坦雪崩中丧生

summary.en: Renowned mountaineer Nirmal Purja, famous for scaling the world's 14 highest peaks in just over six months in 2019, has died in an avalanche in Pakistan, his company announced.
summary.zh: 据其公司称，著名登山家尼尔马尔·普尔贾在巴基斯坦雪崩中丧生。他曾于2019年在短短六个多月内攀登了世界全部14座最高峰而闻名。

body.en:
Renowned British-Nepali mountaineer Nirmal Purja is among 10 people killed in an avalanche on Broad Peak in Pakistan, his company has said.

Elite Expeditions said it confirmed with "profound sadness and immense heartbreak" that Purja, 43, had died in Thursday's avalanche. His brother Kamal later wrote: "We will miss you every single day".

Purja, who was born in Nepal and later served in the British army, was known for scaling the world's 14 highest peaks in just over six months in 2019.

The Prince of Wales said he was "truly saddened to hear of the tragic death" of Purja, who he said "served with distinction" as a soldier before "becoming one of the greatest mountaineers".

Purja's death was also confirmed by Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah, who said that "the tragic death of six Nepalese and four other foreign climbers, including world record holder Nirmal Purja, in the Karakoram mountain range of Pakistan, has shocked us".

"The history of their courage, dedication, and contributions will always remain inspiring," the prime minister added.

In a statement, Purja's older brother Kamal wrote: "It is with the heaviest heart that I share the devastating news that my beloved younger brother, Nirmal 'Nimsdai' Purja, and the other climbers are no longer with us.

"Although our hearts are broken, we are incredibly proud of you. Your legacy will live forever," he added.

UK Defence Secretary Wes Streeting said in a post on X: "Incredibly sad to learn of the passing of Nirmal (Nims) Purja and those he was climbing with.

"He was an inspirational man who served in our Armed Forces for many years - and whose incredible mountaineering adventures are known the world over."

Naila Kiani, a spokesperson for the Alpine Club of Pakistan which is involved in the rescue efforts, told BBC's Newshour programme that Purja had led many expeditions that she was on.

Praising his leadership skills, she described him as a "very experienced climber and fearless".

Kiani said the Alpine Club would only announce his death once the body has been recovered - but she added that "we are fearing them all dead".

Teams in Pakistan have been searching for the climbers on the world's 12th-highest summit after an avalanche on the 8,047m (26,400ft) peak in the Karakoram range.

Pakistani officials earlier said the bodies of three climbers from his expedition - American Mallory Geis, Nadhira Ahmed Abdullah Al Harthy from Oman and Pur Bahadur Gurung from Nepal - had been recovered.

The multinational climbing group was being led by Purja. Also known as Nims, he rose to prominence in 2019 when he climbed all 14 of the world's mountains with peaks above 8,000m in 189 days - smashing the previous record by more than seven years.

He became widely known following a Netflix documentary...
body.zh: 著名的英国裔尼泊尔登山家 Nirmal Purja 的公司表示，他是在巴基斯坦布洛阿特峰雪崩中丧生的 10 人之一。 Elite Expeditions 表示，以“深切的悲伤和巨大的心碎”确认 43 岁的普贾在周四的雪崩中身亡。他的兄弟卡迈勒后来写道：“我们每天都会想念你”。 普贾出生于尼泊尔，后来在英国军队服役，他因 2019 年在短短 6 个多月内攀登世界 14 座最高峰而闻名。 威尔士亲王表示，他“对普贾的悲惨死亡感到非常悲伤”，他说普贾在“成为最伟大的登山家之一”之前作为一名士兵“表现出色”。 尼泊尔总理巴伦德拉·沙阿也证实了普贾的死讯，他表示，“六名尼泊尔人和其他四名外国登山者，包括世界纪录保持者尼尔马尔·普贾，在巴基斯坦喀喇昆仑山脉不幸身亡，令我们震惊”。 总理补充说：“他们的勇气、奉献和贡献的历史将永远鼓舞人心。” 普贾的哥哥卡迈勒在一份声明中写道：“我怀着最沉重的心情告诉大家这个毁灭性的消息，我深爱的弟弟尼尔马尔·普贾和其他登山者不再和我们在一起了。 “虽然我们的心都碎了，但我们为你感到无比自豪。你的遗产将永远存在，”他补充道。 英国国防部长韦斯·斯特里廷 (Wes Streeting) 在 X 上发帖称：“得知尼尔马尔·普贾 (Nirmal (Nims) Purja) 以及与他一起登山的人们去世的消息，我感到非常悲伤。 “他是一位鼓舞人心的人，在我们的武装部队服役多年，他令人难以置信的登山冒险举世闻名。” 参与救援工作的巴基斯坦阿尔卑斯山俱乐部发言人奈拉·基亚尼 (Naila Kiani) 告诉英国广播公司 (BBC) 的“新闻小时”节目，普贾曾带领她参加过多次探险活动。 她赞扬了他的领导能力，称他是一位“经验丰富且无所畏惧的登山者”。 基亚尼说，只有在尸体被找到后，阿尔卑斯俱乐部才会宣布他的死亡，但她补充说，“我们担心他们都死了”。 喀喇昆仑山脉海拔 8,047m（26,400 英尺）的山峰发生雪崩后，巴基斯坦的登山队一直在世界第 12 高的山峰上寻找登山者。 巴基斯坦官员早些时候表示，探险队中的三名登山者的尸体已经找到，他们分别是美国马洛里·盖斯(American Mallory Geis)、阿曼的纳迪拉·艾哈迈德·阿卜杜拉·阿尔哈蒂(Nadhira Ahmed Abdullah Al Harthy)和尼泊尔的普尔·巴哈杜尔·古隆(Pur Bahadur Gurung)。 这个跨国攀岩团体由普贾领导。他也被称为 Nims，于 2019 年声名鹊起，他在 189 天内攀登了世界上全部 14 座海拔 8,000m 以上的山峰，将之前的记录打破了七年多。 他因一部 Netflix 纪录片而广为人知……

reflection.en: The news of a celebrated mountaineer's sudden death reminds us of the universal truth of human mortality. Despite remarkable achievements, life's ultimate end is appointed for all, prompting reflection on what truly endures beyond our earthly endeavors. This reality invites us to consider the brevity of life and the eternal perspective Yahweh offers.
reflection.zh: 一位著名登山家突然离世的消息，提醒我们人类终有一死的普遍真理。尽管取得了非凡的成就，生命的最终结局对所有人都是注定的，这促使我们反思在尘世的努力之外，真正永恒的是什么。这一现实邀请我们思考生命的短暂以及雅伟所提供的永恒视角。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: Hungary to shut sole nuclear plant for first time on Sunday
title.zh: 匈牙利将首次关闭其唯一的核电站

summary.en: Record-low water levels on the Danube forced the Paks plant offline, leaving Hungary facing a potential power crunch.
summary.zh: 多瑙河水位创历史新低，迫使匈牙利帕克斯核电站停运，导致该国面临潜在的电力危机。

body.en:
Record-low water levels on the Danube forced the Paks plant offline, leaving Hungary facing a potential power crunch.

Hungary will shut down the Paks nuclear power plant on Sunday for the first time in its 44-year history, Prime Minister Peter Magyar said.

He made the announcement on social media late Saturday night, saying the decision was taken after a further drop in the Danube's water level .

The plant, located 120 kilometers (74.5 miles) south of the capital, Budapest, uses water from the Danube to cool its reactors. It provides more than 40% of Hungary's electricity generation.

The Danube has fallen to record-low levels in some areas after months of below-average rainfall and successive heat waves since May.

Hungary's water authority projected that the Danube, which flows from Germany to the Black Sea, would fall further in the coming days.

It measured the Danube's water level in Budapest at 23 centimeters (9 inches) on Wednesday morning, well below the previous record low of 33 centimeters (13 inches) set in 2018.

As a result, output at the Paks nuclear power plant had already been cut earlier in the week and some reactors shut down.

"Due to a further decline in the Danube's water level, the second-to-last generating unit at the Paks nuclear power plant will be shut down at 1:30 a.m. (2330 GMT)," the prime minister said.

"As a result, the plant is now producing only 240 megawatts (of electricity), and tomorrow (on Sunday), for the first time in 44 years, it will be completely shut down," Magyar added.

The surge in imported electricity prices could cost Hungary between 120 billion and 240 billion forints ($315 million to $630 million, €273 million to €546 million), Tisza Party Vice Chairman Mark Radnai said on Facebook.

Magyar warned the Paks plant could remain offline for weeks and said his government would seek voluntary power cuts from large users, in addition to the 240 megawatts already pledged, with penalties for noncompliance. 

A decree would also allow grid operator MAVIR to mandate consumption cuts and temporarily disconnect large users if necessary.

body.zh: 多瑙河创纪录的低水位迫使帕克斯工厂停产，使匈牙利面临潜在的电力短缺。 匈牙利总理彼得·马扎尔 (Peter Magyar) 表示，匈牙利将于周日关闭帕克斯核电站，这是该国 44 年历史上的首次。 周六深夜，他在社交媒体上宣布了这一消息，称这一决定是在多瑙河水位进一步下降后做出的。 该核电站位于首都布达佩斯以南 120 公里（74.5 英里）处，使用多瑙河的水来冷却其反应堆。它提供了匈牙利40%以上的发电量。 自五月份以来，经历了几个月低于平均水平的降雨量和连续的热浪之后，多瑙河在一些地区已降至历史最低水位。 匈牙利水务部门预计，从德国流向黑海的多瑙河水位将在未来几天进一步下降。 周三早上测量的布达佩斯多瑙河水位为 23 厘米（9 英寸），远低于 2018 年创下的 33 厘米（13 英寸）的历史最低水位。 因此，本周早些时候帕克斯核电站的发电量已被削减，一些反应堆也被关闭。 “由于多瑙河水位进一步下降，帕克斯核电站倒数第二台发电机组将于凌晨 1 点 30 分（格林威治标准时间 2330）关闭，”总理表示。 Magyar 补充道：“因此，该工厂目前仅生产 240 兆瓦（电力），而明天（周日），该工厂将在 44 年来首次完全关闭。” 蒂萨党副主席马克·拉德奈 (Mark Radnai) 在 Facebook 上表示，进口电价的飙升可能会让匈牙利损失 1200 亿至 2400 亿福林（3.15 亿美元至 6.3 亿美元，2.73 亿欧元至 5.46 亿欧元）。 Magyar 警告 Paks 发电厂可能会关闭数周，并表示，除了已经承诺的 240 兆瓦电力外，政府还将寻求大用户自愿断电，并对违规行为进行处罚。 一项法令还将允许电网运营商 MAVIR 强制削减用电量，并在必要时暂时断开大用户的连接。 不要让算法隐藏新闻。如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

reflection.en: The news of Hungary's nuclear plant shutdown due to record-low water levels reminds us of our dependence on natural resources and the fragility of our systems. Even when facing scarcity and potential hardship, the prophet Habakkuk encourages us to find joy in Yahweh, our strength. This perspective can help us navigate challenges with resilience and trust.
reflection.zh: 匈牙利核电站因多瑙河水位创历史新低而停运的消息，提醒我们对自然资源的依赖以及我们系统固有的脆弱性。即使面对稀缺和潜在的困境，先知哈巴谷也鼓励我们在雅伟——我们的力量中找到喜乐。这种视角能帮助我们以韧性和信靠来应对挑战。

verse.textEn: Though the fig tree does not bud and there are no grapes on the vines... yet I will rejoice in Yahweh.
verse.textZh: 虽然无花果树不发旺，葡萄树不结果……然而，我要因雅伟欢欣。

title.en: How Spain's migrant crisis created a political storm - whipped up by social media
title.zh: 西班牙移民危机如何在社交媒体煽动下引发政治风暴

summary.en: The Ceuta crossings have politically shaken Europe, exposing deep divisions over the sensitive issue of migration, a BBC report indicates. Social media has played a role in intensifying the political storm surrounding these events.
summary.zh: 英国广播公司报道称，休达边境的移民潮在政治上震动了欧洲，暴露了在敏感的移民问题上的深刻分歧。社交媒体在加剧围绕这些事件的政治风暴中发挥了作用。

body.en:
Most of the tens of thousands of migrants who swam into the Spanish exclave of Ceuta on Thursday have now returned to Morocco, escorted to the border by Spanish soldiers and police.

But the extraordinary surge of arrivals has left at least 67 people dead, their bodies pulled from the sea where they floated alongside abandoned rubber rings and flippers.

This week's events have also shaken Europe politically, once again exposing divisions over the sensitive issue of migration.

And they've left lingering questions about what sparked the sudden influx: whether social media posts promising an easy path to Europe just went viral or this was something more deliberate, even organised.

Whatever the cause, Spain's socialist prime minister is angry with the response.

Pedro Sanchez has hit out at some in the EU for "attacking" Spain in this crisis, playing politics instead of showing support.

Fratelli d'Italia, the hard-right party of Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni, had been quick to post images of migrants racing through the streets of Ceuta.

"This is the Sanchez model the Italian left wing likes so much," the caption crowed.

Meloni then announced she was suspending Italy's Schengen agreement with Spain that allows for the free movement of people, citing a security threat.

The way Spain sees it, the crisis has been contained and Ceuta is not in the Schengen zone so Moroccan migrants were never going to head for mainland Europe, unchecked.

But she faces elections next year with her coalition losing ground to a new and virulently anti-immigrant party. This was a chance to sound tough herself and claw back votes and she leaped on it.

Meloni's call for an urgent meeting of interior ministers to be held on Tuesday was signed by almost two dozen EU heads of state, calling for the elimination of all policies that could be "pull factors" to Europe.

Above all, they mean Spain's controversial move to allow hundreds of thousands of undocumented migrants apply for residence and work permits and "regularise" their status.

But those who flocked to the beaches of Ceuta this week were not heading to sign up for a campaign that's already closed.

Sanchez himself points instead to a recent ruling by Spain's Supreme Court: it said those who enter by sea cannot be pushed back immediately.

The prime minister argues that was misrepresented by smugglers to promise an easy path to Europe.

The crowd heading for Ceuta didn't need to pay smugglers, though, because most were Moroccan and the route is well known.

Migrants have shown social media posts to reporters with people shouting that "Spain is Open" and jumping into the sea.

Multiple accounts we've checked ourselves show young people in wetsuits and flippers, or filming themselves already swimming, mixed with...
body.zh: 周四涌入西班牙飞地休达的数万名移民中的大多数现已在西班牙士兵和警察的护送下返回摩洛哥。 但涌入的人数激增，导致至少 67 人死亡，他们的尸体与废弃的橡胶圈和脚蹼一起漂浮在海面上。 本周的事件也在政治上震动了欧洲，再次暴露了在敏感的移民问题上的分歧。 他们留下了一个挥之不去的问题，即是什么引发了突然涌入的人潮：社交媒体上承诺通往欧洲的便捷道路的帖子是否只是病毒式传播，还是这是经过深思熟虑、甚至有组织的。 无论出于何种原因，西班牙社会党首相都对这种反应感到愤怒。 佩德罗·桑切斯猛烈抨击欧盟一些人在这场危机中“攻击”西班牙，玩弄政治而不是表示支持。 意大利兄弟会（Fratelli d'Italia）是总理乔治亚·梅洛尼（Giorgia Meloni）领导的极右翼政党，该党很快就发布了移民在休达街道上奔跑的照片。 “这就是意大利左翼非常喜欢的桑切斯模式，”标题欢呼道。 梅洛尼随后宣布，她以安全威胁为由，暂停意大利与西班牙允许人员自由流动的申根协议。 在西班牙看来，危机已经得到遏制，而且休达也不在申根区，因此摩洛哥移民永远不会不受限制地前往欧洲大陆。 但她面临明年的选举，她的联盟将输给一个新的、恶毒的反移民政党。这是一个让自己听起来强硬并夺回选票的机会，她抓住了这个机会。 梅洛尼呼吁周二召开内政部长紧急会议，这一呼吁得到了近二十位欧盟国家元首的签署，呼吁取消所有可能对欧洲产生“拉动因素”的政策。 最重要的是，他们指的是西班牙允许数十万无证移民申请居留和工作许可证并“规范”他们的身份的有争议的举措。 但本周涌入休达海滩的人们并不打算报名参加已经结束的活动。 桑切斯本人则提到了西班牙最高法院最近的一项裁决：该裁决称，不能立即将通过海路入境的人驱逐。 首相辩称，走私者歪曲了这一点，承诺提供一条通往欧洲的便捷道路。 不过，前往休达的人群不需要付钱给走私者，因为大多数是摩洛哥人，而且路线众所周知。 移民向记者展示了社交媒体帖子，人们高喊“西班牙开放”并跳入海中。 我们检查过的多个账户显示，年轻人穿着潜水衣和脚蹼，或者拍摄自己已经游泳的样子，混合着……

reflection.en: The political storm surrounding migration in Europe, amplified by social media, highlights the challenge of welcoming those seeking refuge. Yahweh's ancient command reminds us to treat foreigners as native-born, loving them as ourselves, recalling our own shared human experience of being strangers. This principle calls for compassion and unity amidst the...
reflection.zh: 欧洲围绕移民问题引发的政治风暴，在社交媒体的推波助澜下，凸显了接纳寻求庇护者的挑战。雅伟古老的诫命提醒我们，要善待寄居者如同本地人，爱他们如同爱自己，因为我们都曾是异乡客。这一原则呼吁我们在复杂的社会问题所造成的隔阂中，展现出怜悯与合一。

verse.textEn: When a foreigner resides among you in your land, do not mistreat them. The foreigner residing among you must be treated as your native-born. Love them as yourself, for you were foreigners in Egypt.
verse.textZh: 若有外人在你们国中和你同居，就不可欺负他。和你们同居的外人，你们要看他如本地人一样，并要爱他如己，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。

title.en: Renowned Nepali mountaineer Nirmal Purja among 10 killed in Pakistan avalanche
title.zh: 尼泊尔著名登山家尼尔马尔·普尔贾等10人在巴基斯坦雪崩中遇难

summary.en: Renowned Nepali mountaineer Nirmal Purja and nine others were tragically killed in an avalanche on Broad Peak, with rescue efforts ongoing to retrieve their bodies.
summary.zh: 尼泊尔著名登山家尼尔马尔·普尔贾与其他九人在布洛阿特峰遭遇雪崩不幸遇难，救援人员仍在努力寻找他们的遗体。

body.en:
Celebrated Nepali climber Nirmal Purja, who set a record for the fastest ascent of the world's 14 highest mountains, died in an avalanche during an expedition in Pakistan, his company said on Saturday.

"Today it is with profound sadness and immense heartbreak that we confirm that Nirmal 'Nimsdai' Purja tragically lost his life following the avalanche on Broad Peak, his expedition organising company Elite Exped said in an Instagram post.

"We have also received confirmation that other members of the expedition sadly did not survive," it added.

Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah said he was stunned at the deaths of the climbers, including Purja.

"Only physical journey of the climbers has stopped. But the history of their courage, dedication and contributions will always remain alive and inspiring," Shah wrote in a social media post.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Purja, 43, and nine others had been missing since Thursday after being struck by an avalanche on the 8,051-metre Broad Peak, the world's 12th-highest mountain, a technically difficult climb in Pakistan's Gilgit-Baltistan region.

Officials said the bodies of Purja and other climbers were located in a difficult site and had yet to be retrieved.

Purja, who served in the British military with the Gurkhas and later in special forces, completed his record-breaking feat in six months in 2019.

He became widely known internationally after the Netflix documentary chronicling his journey, "14 Peaks: Nothing Is Impossible," was released two years later.

UK defence minister Wes Streeting said he was "incredibly" sad to learn of the death of Purja and the other climbers.

"He was an inspirational man who served in our Armed Forces for many years - and whose incredible mountaineering adventures are known the world over," Streeting wrote on X.

The 10 mountaineers were caught in an avalanche around midday on Thursday. Six of them were Nepalis, and the others were from ⁠Pakistan, Oman, the US and China.

Chhang Dawa Sherpa, a board director of Seven Summit Treks, which had three Sherpa guides among the dead ⁠climbers, said the remaining bodies were "spotted and identified" with the help of drone footage and were yet to be retrieved.

"They are in a difficult spot and have not been retrieved yet," Chhang told Reuters news agency.

He said that unlike Nepal, Pakistan does not have the practice of long-line rescue by helicopters on the mountains.

"We have to take into account the safety of those who go and retrieve the bodies."

summary.en: Ceuta faced a crisis after tens of thousands of migrants arrived in one day — equivalent to nearly two-thirds of its population.

body.en:
A tiny Spanish territory on the northern tip of Africa has become the focus of international attention — and debate — after more than 50,000 migrants crossed into it in a mass rush that left at least 67 people dead.

The European Union will hold crisis talks after the mass crossing into Ceuta on Thursday. Most of the migrants had returned to Morocco within 48 hours of crossing, but the incident has raised alarm among European leaders about the bloc's shared border security.

Ceuta has steadily fortified its border over the years as it became a key route for migrants trying to reach Europe.

The Spanish exclave already had a border fence with Morocco, but Spanish authorities have since begun installing a 500m-long floating barrier on its sea border with its African neighbour.

It's designed to stand 30 to 70cm above water and extend as much as one metre below the surface, while a channel between the barriers will allow Civil Guard vessels to patrol the area, the government said.

The arrivals were equivalent to nearly two-thirds of Ceuta's permanent population of about 83,000.

Ceuta and Melilla, another Spanish exclave on the North African coast, are the only two land borders between the European Union and Africa.

Many arrivals swam to Ceuta around the Tarajal breakwater — a sea wall extending out from the Spain-Morocco border into the Mediterranean — to come ashore at Tarajal beach.

"Spain gives you the chance to make your future, not like Morocco," Buji, a 21-year-old Moroccan who is studying to be a teacher, told the Associated Press (AP). "I am a talented boy. I just want a chance."

He said he lost his belongings and money in the crossing, and when he realised that he would likely face legal limbo and detention, he turned back.

"I’ve spent perhaps 14 years studying, but there’s nothing at home, and I'd have to work 12-hour shifts for a meagre wage," he told AP.

"That’s why I came here, but I haven’t found any opportunities here either, so I have to go back."

To reach the city, migrants have been known to swim around 5km from the Moroccan town of Fnideq.

Officials said at least 67 bodies were recovered on the Spanish side after some migrants drowned and others were crushed while trying to climb the breakwater and border fence.

Many were driven to migrate by economic hardship and reportedly by rumours circulating on Moroccan social media that border security had been relaxed.

title.en: Homemade bomb goes off outside upscale Moscow restaurant state officials say
title.zh: 俄罗斯官员称莫斯科高档餐厅外发生自制炸弹爆炸事件

summary.en: Russian authorities said the blast occurred outside a restaurant on Kudrinskaya Square when a woman allegedly carrying explosives was stopped by a security guard.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯当局表示，爆炸发生在库德林斯卡娅广场一家餐厅外，一名据称携带爆炸物的女子被一名保安拦下。

body.en:
Russian authorities said the blast occurred outside a restaurant on Kudrinskaya Square when a woman allegedly carrying explosives was stopped by a security guard.

An explosion at a restaurant in central Moscow killed at least three people, including the suspected bomber on Saturday night, authorities said.

Russia's Anti-Terrorism Committee said a woman carrying  "a homemade explosive device" tried to enter the restaurant on Kudrinskaya Square but was stopped by a security guard.

The device exploded at the entrance, killing the woman, the guard and a restaurant patron.

State news agency RIA Novosti reported that at least 21 other people were injured in the blast, which occurred shortly before 8 p.m. local time (5 p.m. UTC).

The restaurant's website said the venue had been closed on Saturday for a private event.

Heavily armed law enforcement officers sealed off the area and launched an investigation.

Authorities did not immediately identify those they believed to be behind the attack.

Russia has faced several attacks since the start of the war in Ukraine in 2022. They blamed a ‌series of assassinations and attempted killings on Kyiv. Russian authorities have yet to comment on any possible Ukrainian involvement into the Kudrinskaya Square blast.

However, Ukraine used drones to attack other parts of Russia on Saturday evening and early on Sunday, including a bombing which targeted an apartment block and killed two in the city Engels, some 900 kilometers (560 miles) southeast of Moscow.

Russia's Defense Ministry also said Kyiv struck a warehouse belonging to Wildberries, a major online retailer in Russia, with the Ukrainian drones hitting a site in the Samara Oblast, deep inside Russian territory. Regional Governor Vyacheslav Fedorishchev said it was not immediately clear if there were any casualties

Russian officials also reported over a 100 Ukrainian strikes in the Belgorod Oblast, which borders Ukraine. They said Kyiv forces used artillery, rocket launchers, and drones,  with 14 people injured. Russian officials claim over 200 Ukrainian drones have been shot down during the wave of attacks.

Meanwhile, at least one person was killed and seven wounded in the Russian attack on Ukraine's Kherson, with the attack involving artillery fire, and seven passengers were wounded in a drone strike on a minibus, with the regional military administrator Oleksandr Hanzha describing it as a "deliberate and cynical attack on civilians."

At least nine people were killed and 33 injured in Russian strikes on Kyiv earlier this weekend.

body.en:
An improvised explosive device detonated at a restaurant in central Moscow killing at least three people on Saturday, including the bomber, Russian state media said, citing local officials.

At least 21 people were also injured when the IED detonated at the restaurant on Kudrinskaya Square in Moscow at about 8pm local time (3am Sunday AEST), the National Anti-Terrorism Committee said, quoted by Russian state news agency RIA Novosti.

An unidentified woman who attempted to carry the explosive device into the restaurant died in the blast, as did a security guard and a patron, the news agency said.

RIA Novosti reported the woman attempted to smuggle the IED into the establishment but the security guard refused to let her in before the bomb exploded.

The attack was still being investigated, the Moscow Investigative Committee told the news agency.

title.en: How does eastern Europe commemorate the Roma Holocaust?
title.zh: 东欧如何纪念罗姆人大屠杀？

summary.en: The European Union designated August 2 as European Roma Holocaust Memorial Day in 2015. While Germany observes the day with memorial services and educational activities, the article questions how eastern European nations commemorate this significant event.
summary.zh: 2015年，欧盟将8月2日定为欧洲罗姆人大屠杀纪念日。德国通过纪念仪式、教育活动和公开演讲来纪念这一天，而文章则探讨了东欧国家如何纪念这一事件。

body.en:
In 2015, the EU designated August 2 as the European Roma Holocaust Memorial Day. In Germany, the day is marked with memorial services, educational activites and public addresses. And in eastern Europe?

It took decades before Germany recognized the Romani Holocaust — the Nazi genocide of 500,000 European Roma and Sinti during World War II . Several more decades passed before the European Holocaust Memorial Day for Sinti and Roma became an official German and European day of remembrance, celebrated each year on August 2.

Based on initiatives by Polish Roma groups, the Nazi liquidation of the so-called "Gypsy Family Camp" in the Auschwitz-Birkenau Concentration and Extermination Camp on the evening of August 2-3, 1944, was first commemorated half a century later, in 1994. 

Thousands of deported Roma and Sinti had already been killed as a result of malnutrition and disease. That evening, thousands more were forced into gas chambers, shot and beaten to death by Nazi henchmen.

In 2015, the European Parliament declared this date the European Roma Holocaust Memorial Day. In Germany and other European countries, the genocide is commemorated by officials with the participation of government representatives. In some cases, representatives of European governments travel to the memorial site in Auschwitz.

In most cases, however, countries hold their own memorial services — particularly in central and southeastern Europe, where Nazi extermination commonly targeted Romani peoples . These days, such memorial days also take the opportunity to raise awareness for ongoing Antiziganism and the consequences it has. 

Poland , home to an estimated 30,000 Roma, has been observing August 2 since 2011. The ceremony routinely includes a visit by parliamentary and governmental representatives to the Auschwitz Memorial.

Another important day of remembrance is observed each year in the village of Szczurowa, east of Krakow, on July 3. It honors the memory of Polish Roma massacred by German troops in 1943. In 1956, Szczurowa became the first site of a European memorial for victims of the Romani Holocaust.

Other small towns and villages across southeastern Poland also commemorate the killing of Polish Roma during Nazi German occupation. 

In the Czech Republic , where nearly 250,000 Roma live, August 2 has been an official day of remembrance since 2015. The most important ceremony is held in Lety, south of Prague, where Roma organizations have been commemorating the genocide for decades. title.en: War in Ukraine: Why Crimea has become a strategic target

summary.en: Ukraine has intensified its attacks on Russian logistics and energy facilities in Crimea, raising questions about the impact on local supplies and Kyiv's strategy to influence the war's trajectory.

body.en:
Ukraine has stepped up attacks on Russian logistics centers and energy facilities in Crimea. What are the consequences for local supplies, and how does Kyiv hope this strategy will affect the course of the war?

In an attempt to isolate Crimea  from the mainland, the Ukrainian armed forces have intensified their attacks on the peninsula, which was invaded and annexed by Russia in 2014.

Ukraine is using long-range drones to attack transports on the M14 highway between the Russian city of Rostov-on-Don and Melitopol in occupied southern Ukraine. It is also targeting Russian shadow fleet ships in the Sea of Azov and the Black Sea , as well as energy facilities that supply the Russian military.

Robert "Magyar" Brovdi, commander of the Ukrainian forces for unmanned systems, says 196 Russian ships and more than 100 energy facilities have been hit in the past month alone. His figures cannot be independently verified.

Russia appears to be struggling to supply both its military and the civilian population in Crimea. Fuel coupons were issued at the end of May, but ran out after 24 hours, after which gasoline was being traded on the black market. A state of emergency was declared in Crimea, especially Sevastopol, in response to repeated disruption of the electricity and water supply, and of the internet and cellphone networks.

Nina, a pensioner who lives in a village near Feodosiya, southeastern Crimea, told DW about the difficulties people there are facing: Residents there can't cook because of power cuts, and fuel shortages mean public transport only runs intermittently. Nina's worst fear, though, is not having electricity in winter.

The longest power cuts have been in the north of Crimea. This is where Ivan lives [name changed]. He tells DW that for some time, people were unable to get hold of fuel with either coupons or cash. The only exceptions, he says, were police officers, state officials, and doctors. For several days, everything collapsed: Cars ran out of fuel and simply came to a stop; people didn't know how they were supposed to get to where they were going.

Ivan said that most shops no longer stock perishable goods, because they can't run their fridges and freezers: "There are no milk products, or fish, or meat," he said. "There are only a few shops with electricity generators, but the prices there are much higher than before."

Some small, private, volunteer initiatives are trying to help. The blogger Olena Gerasimenko works with companies in Simferopol to bring drinking water to people suffering from power cuts, and to hospitals and kindergartens. In her blog, she reports that people are complaining about the lack of help from the Russian-installed "authorities" in Crimea.

title.en: UK court allows plans for Chinese 'super' embassy to advance

summary.en: A UK court has dismissed a legal challenge against Beijing's new embassy in London, which is set to become the largest in the UK. The case, brought by a neighborhood association, had cited security concerns regarding the embassy's presence.
summary.zh: 英国一家法院驳回了针对中国驻伦敦新大使馆的法律挑战，该大使馆建成后将成为英国最大的使馆。此案由一个社区协会提起，理由是该大使馆构成安全威胁。

body.en:
A court dismissed a legal challenge against Beijing's new embassy in London, which could become the largest in the UK. The case, brought by a neighborhood association, argued the embassy poses a security threat.

A UK High Court on Friday threw out a challenge against UK authorities' decision to permit a new Chinese super embassy in central London .

The challenge was brought by a neighborhood group called the Royal Mint Court Residents' Association (RMCRA), which represents families and businesses in roughly 100 properties around the planned embassy site.

The RMCRA argued the presence of the embassy could increase the risk of terrorist attacks, lead to the targeting of dissidents and be used to enforce "draconian" Chinese laws in the UK.

The association also claimed that the embassy could pose a fire risk, arguing that Chinese authorities might ignore safety obligations that would be difficult to enforce because of diplomatic immunity on the embassy site.

On that basis, the group argued the development should not have been approved by the UK government as well as the London Borough of Tower Hamlets.

Yet in its ruling on Friday, the High Court said the "RMCRA ​did not produce reasonable ⁠and convincing evidence of the likelihood that a violation of human rights ⁠affecting them ​personally would occur."

In a move that was widely seen as a goodwill gesture toward Beijing, the embassy received approval from the UK government shortly before then-Prime Minister Keir Starmer visited China in January this year. 

 If completed, the new Chinese embassy would be the largest embassy in the UK .

Beijing plans to build the embassy on the site of the former Royal Mint, next to the Tower of London. The site covers around 20,000 square meters (235,000 square feet).

Beijing purchased the property in 2018 for a reported $327 million (€283.9 million), with the intent of relocating its embassy there from its current premises in Portland Place.

In response to the verdict, the RMCRA said it would seek permission to appeal, hoping to take the case to the UK Supreme Court.

"Beijing thinks this judgment is the final word. It isn't. The appeal is already in the works," Luke Pollard, head of the RMCRA, said in a statement.

Activists from  Hong Kong's pro-democracy movement living in exile have also been skeptical of the project, telling DW they fear the embassy could help Beijing suppress dissidents abroad. 

The UK is home to the world's largest Hong Kong diaspora, with an estimated 285,000 people of Hong Kong origin living in the country.

title.zh: 世界著名登山家尼尔马尔·普尔贾等11人在巴基斯坦山脉遭遇雪崩

summary.en: World-renowned climber Nirmal Purja was among 11 mountaineers caught in a deadly avalanche on Broad Peak in Pakistan. Rescuers have found four bodies as the search continues for the team.
summary.zh: 世界著名登山家尼尔马尔·普尔贾是11名在巴基斯坦布洛阿特峰遭遇致命雪崩的登山者之一。救援人员已找到四具遗体，搜寻工作仍在进行中。

body.en: Rescuers say four bodies found in search for team caught in Broad Peak avalanche, after trackers showed rapid descent The world-renowned Nepali mountaineer Nirmal Purja – a former British special forces member – is among 11 climbers caught in a deadly avalanche on Pakistan’s Broad Peak. The Alpine Club of Pakistan said “seven climbers have been spotted via aerial drone footage” adding that “their identities and condition cannot yet be verified”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 救援人员称，在追踪器显示快速下降后，在寻找布洛阿特峰雪崩中陷入雪崩的登山队时，发现了四具尸体。世界著名的尼泊尔登山家尼尔马尔·普贾（Nirmal Purja）是一名前英国特种部队成员，他是巴基斯坦布洛阿特峰遭遇雪崩的 11 名登山者之一。巴基斯坦高山俱乐部表示，“通过无人机航拍发现了七名登山者”，并补充说“他们的身份和状况尚未得到证实”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The tragic news of climbers caught in an avalanche reminds us of life's fragility and the suddenness of loss. In moments of profound grief and pain, we hold onto the promise that one day Yahweh will wipe away every tear. This hope assures us that suffering, mourning, and death will ultimately pass away.
reflection.zh: 登山者遭遇雪崩的悲剧性新闻提醒我们生命的脆弱和失去的突然。在极度悲伤和痛苦的时刻，我们紧紧抓住雅伟有一天将擦去我们所有眼泪的应许。这个盼望向我们保证，苦难、哀伤和死亡终将过去。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: From petitions to memes: How students made dissent visible
title.zh: 从请愿到网络迷因：学生如何让异议显现

summary.en: Student movements throughout history, from imperial China to modern India, have consistently found new ways to express dissent and challenge established authority, adapting their methods to contemporary tools and symbols.
summary.zh: 从中国古代到当今印度，学生运动不断调整其工具和象征，以挑战权威，使异议得以显现。

body.en:
From imperial China to present-day India, student movements have repeatedly adapted the tools and symbols of their age to challenge authority.

On July 22, 2026, in rainy Mumbai, India , a casually dressed young woman stepped in front of a slow-moving police van carrying detained students. She placed her palm on the hood, forcing the vehicle to stop.

Mobile phones captured the moment from every angle. She too, raised her own phone and recorded the encounter. Within hours, the clip spread across India and beyond.

It became one of the defining visuals of the Cockroach Janta Party protests, a movement in which students demanded transparency and accountability, following leaks in India's medical entrance exams.

But the power of the moment lay not only in what she did, but in how quickly it was seen. A single gesture, a young woman confronting authority , became a symbol shared across millions of screens.

While the clip belongs to a generation raised on social media, the impulse behind it is much older.

From court petitions and revolutionary posters to photographs, umbrellas and memes, student movements have repeatedly adapted the tools and symbols available to them, turning them into vehicles for dissent.

Long before television or social media carried dissent across borders, students still found ways to make their grievances heard.

In Eastern Han China, for instance, scholars at the Imperial Academy (Taixue) aligned with reform-minded officials in opposing powerful eunuchs at court, whom many viewed as corrupt and politically overbearing.

They voiced their objections through public criticism, political networks and petitions.

In an era when political communication moved through official channels, petitions were among the established ways of bringing grievances before the throne. Written in formal language and delivered through the bureaucracy, they carried student concerns directly into the state's communication system.

In Paris in 1968, students challenged university authorities and a conservative postwar social order. As demonstrations spread across the French capital and drew in workers, one of the movement's most enduring contributions emerged from a basement workshop at the Ecole des Beaux-Arts.

The Atelier Populaire ("People's Workshop") printed thousands of posters during the protests, many of them overnight. Their bold graphics, silhouettes and slogans became the visual language of the movement. Produced collectively, many carried no individual author's name, helping transform protest into a shared public voice.

The posters and their messages could appear in dozens of places overnight, giving the protest a wide local visual presence.

Protests also became more impactful when images could be transmitted across borders.

body.zh: 从中华帝国到当今的印度，学生运动不断地采用他们那个时代的工具和符号来挑战权威。 2026 年 7 月 22 日，在多雨的印度孟买，一名穿着休闲的年轻女子走到一辆载着被拘留学生的缓慢行驶的警车前。她将手掌放在引擎盖上，迫使车辆停了下来。 手机从各个角度捕捉了这一时刻。她也举起了自己的手机，记录了这次遭遇。几个小时内，这段视频就传遍了印度及其他地区。 它成为蟑螂简塔党抗议活动的标志性视觉效果之一，在印度医学入学考试泄密后，学生们在这场运动中要求透明度和问责制。 但这一刻的​​力量不仅在于她所做的事情，还在于她的所作所为很快被人们看到。一个年轻女子对抗权威的一个动作，成为了数百万屏幕上共享的符号。 虽然这段视频属于在社交媒体上长大的一代人，但其背后的冲动却要古老得多。 从法庭请愿书和革命海报到照片、雨伞和模因，学生运动不断地调整他们可用的工具和符号，将它们变成异议的工具。 早在电视或社交媒体跨境传播异议之前，学生们就已经找到了表达不满的方法。 例如，在中国东汉，太学的学者与具有改革思想的官员结盟，反对宫廷中有权有势的宦官，许多人认为宦官腐败且在政治上专横。 他们通过公开批评、政治网络和请愿来表达他们的反对意见。 在政治沟通通过官方渠道进行的时代，请愿是向王室表达不满的既定方式之一。它们以正式语言编写并通过官僚机构传达，将学生的担忧直接传达到国家的沟通系统中。 1968 年的巴黎，学生们挑战大学当局和保守的战后社会秩序。随着示威活动在法国首都蔓延并吸引了工人，该运动最持久的贡献之一来自巴黎美术学院的一个地下室工作室。 Atelier Populaire（“人民工作室”）在抗议期间印制了数千张海报，其中许多是在一夜之间印制的。他们大胆的图形、轮廓和口号成为了这场运动的视觉语言。许多作品都是集体制作的，没有作者的名字，这有助于将抗议转变为公众的共同声音。 这些海报及其信息可能会在一夜之间出现在数十个地方，使抗议活动在当地得到广泛的关注。 当图像可以跨境传输时，抗议的影响力也变得更大。 在...

reflection.en: Student movements, by making their dissent visible, often echo a deep human longing for fairness and moral order. Yahweh, through the prophet Amos, calls for justice to flow powerfully and consistently, reminding us that true righteousness should be an undeniable force in society. This pursuit of a more just world often requires courage to speak truth to...
reflection.zh: 学生运动通过使异议显现，常常回应着人类对公平和道德秩序的深切渴望。雅伟通过先知阿摩司呼吁，愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔，提醒我们真正的公义应成为社会中不可否认的力量。这种对更公正世界的追求，往往需要勇气向权力说出真相，即使这意味着挑战现状。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

title.en: Chinese super-embassy in London to go ahead after high court challenge dismissed
title.zh: 中国驻伦敦超级大使馆在高院驳回挑战后将继续建设

summary.en: A high court in London has dismissed a challenge from local residents against the construction of a new Chinese embassy. The residents' association, which sought to stop planning permission, has announced its intention to appeal the ruling.
summary.zh: 伦敦高等法院驳回了当地居民对中国新大使馆建设的挑战。寻求阻止规划许可的居民协会表示将对该裁决提出上诉。

body.en: Royal Mint Court residents’ association, which sought to stop planning permission, says it will appeal against ruling Construction of a controversial new Chinese embassy was given the green light on Friday after the high court dismissed a challenge from neighbours. The Royal Mint Court residents’ association (RMCRA), which brought the case against the government, immediately announced plans to appeal against the decision, in a move that could cause further delays to the project. The debate over planning permission for the new embassy has been a sore point of British-Chinese relations in recent years. Continue reading...
body.zh: 寻求停止规划许可的皇家造币厂居民协会表示，在高等法院驳回邻国的质疑后，周五，有争议的中国新大使馆建设项目获得批准，该协会表示将对裁决提出上诉。对政府提起诉讼的皇家造币厂居民协会 (RMCRA) 立即宣布计划对该决定提出上诉，此举可能会导致该项目进一步延误。关于新使馆规划许可的争论一直是近年来英中关系的一个痛点。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Even amidst legal disputes and community tensions, the call to live peaceably with all people remains a guiding principle. While residents pursue their appeal, this situation reminds us of the ongoing effort required to foster good relationships, even between powerful entities and their neighbors. Yahweh desires that we strive for harmony wherever possible.
reflection.zh: 即使在法律纠纷和社区紧张局势中，与所有人和平相处的呼吁仍然是一个指导原则。当居民们继续上诉时，这种情况提醒我们，即使是强大的实体与邻里之间，也需要持续努力培养良好关系。雅伟希望我们尽可能地追求和谐。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Could AI take your job? Some workers in China already know the answer
title.zh: 人工智能会取代你的工作吗？中国一些工人已经知道了答案

summary.en: Workers across China are expressing concern about the potential impact of artificial intelligence on their jobs and livelihoods, amidst an already unstable labor market.
summary.zh: 在中国各地，工人们对人工智能在日益脆弱的劳动力市场中对其生计的影响感到担忧。

body.en: Across the country, workers are fearful about the impact of AI on their livelihoods in an increasingly fragile labour market On the tree-lined streets of Wuhan, where cars jostle for space with mopeds and cargo trucks, the malfunctioning of a new type of vehicle has recently been causing chaos on the city’s roads. In March, several cars from a fleet of driverless taxis stopped abruptly in the streets. The “system malfunction” left distressed riders stranded for hours. The robotaxis, known as Apollo Go and powered by artificial intelligence (AI), were taken off Wuhan’s streets for months for investigations. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在日益脆弱的劳动力市场中，全国各地的工人们都担心人工智能会对他们的生计产生影响。在武汉绿树成荫的街道上，汽车与轻便摩托车和货运卡车争夺空间，最近一种新型车辆的故障导致该市道路出现混乱。三月份，无人驾驶出租车车队中的几辆车突然停在街上。 “系统故障”让心疼的乘客滞留了几个小时。这辆名为 Apollo Go 的机器人出租车由人工智能 (AI) 驱动，已被带离武汉街道数月以进行调查。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As technological advancements like AI reshape the world of work, it's natural for people to feel anxious about their livelihoods. This verse reminds us that all our labor, when done with diligence and integrity, can be an offering to Yahweh, giving it enduring purpose beyond economic shifts. Even as job roles evolve, the dignity of human contribution...
reflection.zh: 随着人工智能等技术进步重塑工作世界，人们对生计感到焦虑是自然的。这节经文提醒我们，我们所有的劳动，只要勤勉正直地完成，都可以是献给雅伟的供物，使其超越经济变迁而拥有持久的意义。即使工作角色不断演变，人类贡献的尊严依然存在，植根于更高的呼召。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: The future of AI hinges on openness and cooperation. China and Britain can gain much by working together | Zheng Zeguang
title.zh: 人工智能的未来取决于开放与合作。中英两国携手合作可获益良多 | 郑泽光

summary.en: The Chinese ambassador to the UK, Zheng Zeguang, argues that the future of artificial intelligence depends on international openness and cooperation between nations like China and Britain. He emphasizes the significant benefits to be gained through collaborative efforts in areas such as manufacturing, healthcare,...
summary.zh: 中国驻英国大使郑泽光指出，人工智能的未来取决于中英等国之间的国际开放与合作。他强调，通过在制造业、医疗、研究和治理等领域的协作，可以获得巨大的利益，并认为孤立竞争毫无意义。

body.en: There is no point competing in isolation. There are so many benefits to be had, in manufacturing, healthcare, research and governance Zheng Zeguang is the Chinese ambassador to the UK Artificial intelligence is widely regarded as one of the defining technologies of our time. Like the steam engine, the harnessing of electricity and the internet before it, it has the potential to transform how we work, live and interact. But every technological revolution brings challenges as well as opportunities. As AI systems become more capable, people are asking legitimate questions. How can AI remain safe, accountable and under human control ? How should its development be governed? How can its benefits be shared more widely? Continue reading...
body.zh: 孤立地竞争是没有意义的。在制造、医疗保健、研究和治理方面有很多好处。郑泽光是中国驻英国大使人工智能被广泛认为是我们这个时代的决定性技术之一。就像蒸汽机、电力和互联网的利​​用一样，它有可能改变我们的工作、生活和互动方式。但每一次技术革命都带来挑战和机遇。随着人工智能系统变得越来越强大，人们提出了合理的问题。人工智能如何保持安全、负责任并处于人类控制之下？其发展又该如何治理？如何让更广泛的人分享其好处？继续阅读...

reflection.en: The call for international cooperation in AI development echoes the wisdom that collective counsel brings strength and security. When nations work together, sharing insights and resources, they can navigate complex challenges and unlock greater benefits for all. This collaborative spirit, rather than isolated competition, reflects a path of shared wisdom...
reflection.zh: 呼吁在人工智能发展中进行国际合作，这与“谋士众多，人便安居”的智慧不谋而合。当各国携手合作，分享见解和资源时，它们就能应对复杂的挑战，为所有人带来更大的利益。这种协作精神，而非孤立竞争，体现了共享智慧和共同繁荣的道路。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Anthony Fauci’s diaries take aim at News Corp journalist Sharri Markson’s ‘nonsense’ Covid-19 investigation
title.zh: 安东尼·福奇日记抨击新闻集团记者莎莉·马克森“胡说八道”的新冠病毒调查

summary.en: Former US top health official Dr. Anthony Fauci has criticized journalist Sharri Markson's investigation into the origins of Covid-19, describing her reporting as "nonsense" in his diaries. Fauci, who was subpoenaed for a Senate hearing on the pandemic, stated that Markson's claims "do not make any sense."
summary.zh: 美国前首席卫生官员安东尼·福奇博士在他的日记中批评记者莎莉·马克森对新冠病毒起源的调查是“胡说八道”。福奇曾被传唤出席参议院关于新冠疫情的听证会，他表示马克森的报道“没有任何意义”。

body.en: US former top health official, who was subpoenaed to appear at a Senate hearing into Covid-19, says Markson’s reporting about virus’s origin ‘does not make any sense’ Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Dr Anthony Fauci , the US’s chief medical adviser at the start of the pandemic, has described a book by News Corp investigative journalist Sharri Markson backing the “lab leak” theory of Covid-19’s origins as a “bunch of nonsense” in his newly released diaries. This week, Fauci, 85, was subpoenaed by the Republican senator Rand Paul to appear at a Senate hearing into Covid-19 and his handling of the pandemic. Continue reading...
body.zh: 被传唤出席参议院关于 Covid-19 的听证会的美国前高级卫生官员表示，马克森关于病毒起源的报道“没有任何意义”。 大流行开始时，美国首席医疗顾问安东尼·福奇博士将新闻集团调查记者莎莉·马克森 (Sharri Markson) 的一本支持 Covid-19 起源“实验室泄露”理论的书描述为在他新发表的日记中，“一堆废话”。本周，85 岁的福奇接到共和党参议员兰德·保罗的传票，出席参议院关于 Covid-19 及其处理疫情的听证会。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In a world saturated with information, discerning truth from falsehood can be a profound challenge, especially when public figures dispute journalistic accounts. Yahweh calls us to "put away falsehood" and "speak the truth with our neighbor," reminding us of our shared responsibility in public discourse. This encourages us to seek integrity in communication...
reflection.zh: 在一个信息泛滥的世界里，辨别真伪可能是一个巨大的挑战，尤其当公众人物质疑新闻报道时。雅伟呼召我们“脱去谎言，各人与邻舍说实话”，提醒我们在公共话语中共同的责任。这鼓励我们寻求沟通的诚信，并以审慎辨别的精神对待有争议的叙述。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

title.en: US-China AI rivalry heats up as Chinese models gain ground
title.zh: 中美人工智能竞争加剧，中国模型迎头赶上

summary.en: China's AI platforms are rapidly advancing, narrowing the gap with US technology. This progress has led to renewed threats from the Trump administration, alongside accusations of intellectual property theft, raising concerns about escalating tensions between the two nations.
summary.zh: 中国的人工智能平台正迅速缩小与美国同行的差距。这一进展引发了特朗普政府新的威胁，并伴随着知识产权盗窃的指控，令人担忧两国之间的紧张关系可能升级。

body.en:
China's AI platforms are rapidly closing the gap with their US counterparts, prompting fresh threats from the Trump administration. With accusations of intellectual property theft, could tensions boil over?

In what seems like the blink of an eye,  China has gone from being up to five years behind the United States in top-tier artificial intelligence (AI) to lagging by just a few months.

While US players, including Anthropic's Claude and OpenAI's ChatGPT , have spent hundreds of billions of dollars to push the frontier of AI, China has pursued a very different path .

Faced with US curbs on high-end chips that help AI to do its most advanced thinking, Chinese tech firms have prioritized dozens of open-source AI models built on "good enough"  technology .

These platforms, including DeepSeek, Alibaba's Qwen and Xiaomi's MiMo, are now widely deployed across Chinese businesses, government services and consumer devices.

In the latest sign of the gap closing, Chinese startup Moonshot AI last week unveiled Kimi K3, a model that rivals one of the most advanced AI models — Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 — on key benchmarks.

In some tests, Kimi K3 matches or even surpasses Claude with far less computing power and at a fraction of the cost. 

Global technology specialist Alvin W. Graylin thinks Kimi K3's arrival turns high-end AI from an expensive luxury into something practical and affordable.

"For 98% of customers, the 1 to 2% difference [in knowledge] isn't worth paying 10 to 20 times more."

China's latest advance has already drawn a strong reaction from Washington, with US President Donald Trump now threatening to block US access to Chinese AI models.

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, meanwhile, warned earlier this week that the US could sanction Chinese models over alleged intellectual property (IP) theft.

Anthropic  and OpenAI have accused Chinese labs of using their models to train their own systems, a process known as distilling.

While distilling is a common practice by AI labs worldwide to a limited extent, the companies say their models have been bombarded with queries to harvest advanced reasoning. The White House warned in April that China was doing it on an "industrial scale."

Beijing has hit back, rejecting the accusations as baseless and calling US threats of sanctions and model bans "technological bullying" to contain China's rise.

Giulia Neaher, a research analyst at the Strategic Foresight Hub at the Washington-based Stimson Center think tank, downplayed the role of distilling in Kimi's progress.

"A great degree [of its success] is due to the talent, infrastructure and the resources that were poured into building this...
